name: FoFo
description: FoFo is a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' ability to follow complex, domain-specific formats. It includes a diverse range of real-world formats and instructions, assessing format-following proficiency across different domains.
reputation: A niche but useful benchmark for format-following in LLMs, with limited but growing attention in the evaluation community.
notes: Focuses on format-following capability, highlighting differences between open-source and closed-source LLMs.
